history.summary: Freehold 2014 shoebox 1BR in a tiny 34-unit Geylang project. The algo's -15.0% age-adj cheapness is contradicted by the listing being priced clearly ABOVE recent verified transactions - this is an over-asked unit, not a bargain.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $780k at $1,576 psf for 495 sqft. Web-verified Edenz Suites 1BR transactions in Feb 2026 cleared at $680k-$710k ($1,497-$1,548 psf), with the 12-month average around $1,368 psf and an all-time high of only $722k (Apr 2023, 495 sqft). This asking price is ~8-15% above where comparable units actually sell and above the project's historic high - the algo's psf_above_market red flag is correct and the negative age-adj premium is an artifact of age-normalization, not real value. appreciation_pct (3.7%) is only a regional_baseline placeholder (13 txns), so no genuine growth signal. Tiny 34-unit pool means thin resale liquidity. Overpriced entry into a small Geylang shoebox = Avoid for a 5-7yr investment hold.
red_flags: Asking $780k exceeds project all-time high (~$722k) and recent comps of $680k-$710k
Asking ~$1,576 psf vs verified ~$1,368-$1,548 psf actual transactions - over-asked
Tiny 34-unit development = thin liquidity and few comparables
appreciation_pct is a regional_baseline placeholder, not real project data
catalysts: Freehold + walkability to Paya Lebar/Aljunied MRT supports rental tenancy

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: No reliable appreciation signal - source is regional_baseline (not URA project CAGR) over only 13 txns. Trailing momentum has ~0 forward power regardless; this is purely a placeholder.
agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Reported ~5.1% gross yield is the only real positive, but it is computed off a lower fair value (~$700k) not the $780k ask; at the ask the realistic yield drops toward ~4.3-4.5%.
